claims.statement: The MSP (Merchant Service Provider) is a Java/Vert.x payment orchestration platform that exposes a large REST API surface (invoices, payments, refunds, voids, QR, captures, authorizations, tokens) and deploys a `Server` verticle from `Main`, with all runtime behavior controlled via a single `config.json` resource.

The MSP platform achieves provider extensibility through a Strategy Pattern of abstract connector classes (MSPConnector, RSPConnector, CSPConnector, PSPConnector, VoidConnector, BillRspConnector, MerchantConnector, ClientConnector) whose concrete implementations are declared in config arrays and instantiated reflectively at startup in Main via the (String id, JsonObject properties) constructor.

All MSP runtime configuration is loaded from a single config.json file on the classpath into a cached JsonObject by `Config` in a static initializer, and every accessor reads from that cache; configuration changes require a rebuild/restart because there is no hot-reload or externalized override path.
